name: "Pizza Salad" with Sausage, Mushrooms, Mozzarella & Tomato Dressing

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
0.45 kg white mushrooms
1 small pkg fresh basil
3 (142 g) pkgs spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sausages and cook, turning occasionally, until cooked through, 12-15 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
6 pork sausages

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place water, oil, vinegar, tomato paste, maple syrup, Dijon, and spices in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp water
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp apple cider vinegar
3 tbsp tomato paste
1 tbsp pure maple syrup
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice mushrooms. Place on a large plate.
Drain and thinly slice artichoke hearts. Add to the plate with the mushrooms.
Cut mozzarella into bite-sized pieces. Add to the plate.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add to the plate and set aside.
Transfer cooked sausages to the cutting board and slice crosswise into thin rounds.
To serve, divide mixed greens between plates or bowls. Top with mushrooms, artichokes, mozzarella, basil, and sausage. Drizzle with dressing and enjoy!
